media:group.media:title: Outlast Any% Speedrun 6:52.51 (PC)
media:group.media:description:
It finally happened! Skip big enough for me to do more runs. Thanks to Lampoos (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T6F11W7q-wI link to original video of the skip) we can now skip Wernicke talk in the lab (as well as Chris' death scene)!
The skip is very technical and at least so far isn't very consistent. We only know of it working on PC, and using keyboard and mouse.
The gist of it is you need the smaller hitbox that you get from vaulting, then you need to clip into the door to get boosted up. The clipping can happen when you hold D on keyboard and tap W on the corner of the door. You move from left to right until Miles starts to move. If you don't get the clip you reset by going left, then get back to the corner for another try. This is just one way of doing it, there may be more consistent way out there, but the skip was found today. It's really not easy though! You need to get up with the smaller hitbox intact (you lose it as soon as you don't hug a wall). Once you are up you need to manouver left enough so you don't drop down yet you can jump to the other side while keeping the hitbox. On the otherside you just need to get to the corner and hold A and S while running to get the last boost. Once you are up you just get on top of the lamp to get enough height to jump on top of the Lab wall, then make your way beyond the locked door.
The run itself isn't really good, you can see I didn't get first try bush jump, didn't go for all the fastest strats in lab etc. But it's PB nonetheless! I will definitely try to improve. Don't mind the splits, I had some settings wrong in LiveSplit so they didn't all split, had to manually get to the last split so at least I got the end right.

Still pretty happy with the run, although I wish I got the sub 1:58.
